claim: JC Solutions cites more than 40 years of award-winning O&M experience.
The audit program assesses hundreds of operational tasks.
Maintenance QA reports use 30-, 60-, and 90-day reporting intervals.
The annual quality audit allows a 90-day fixed timeframe to address findings and improvement areas.
The stated minimum compliance goal is 100%.
The management and administrative model includes two Administrative Assistants, a full-time onsite Health and Safety Specialist, and 8-hour Monday-through-Friday shifts.
Each large facility staffing model provides three day-shift operators every day and two operators every night shift.
The smaller facility shift pattern uses 4-, 8-, and 12-hour shifts and provides at least three day-shift and two night-shift operators seven days per week.
The proposed staffing plan totals 61 FTE: 7 administrative, 11 at each of three facilities, and 21 maintenance.
One senior-supervisor and one public-information role are each assigned 50% time.
The proposal allocates 4,300 hours annually in its Base Fee for regional and technical support.
JC Solutions identifies $2,200,000 worth of investment in support of the project.
JC Solutions is investing 4,000 hours of training for the onsite team.
JC Solutions identifies $935,000 worth of investment in training and development.
JC Solutions identifies $750,000 worth of investment in workforce development.
